name: Microsoft SQL Server
subtitle: Enterprise relational database (SQL)
creator: Microsoft (originally with Sybase)
description: Microsoft's flagship relational database, dominant in enterprises and .NET shops. It uses the T-SQL dialect and comes with strong tooling, business intelligence features and tight Azure integration.

concepts.explanation: Microsoft's flavor of SQL with procedural extensions.
Logic that runs inside the database.

codeSamples.label: T-SQL

pricing.summary: Express edition is free (with size limits); Developer edition is free for non-production. Standard and Enterprise are licensed per core. Azure SQL is usage-based.
